name: ESP32 touch box
description: An ESP32 board on the phone's USB port or Bluetooth becomes its touch screen, keyboard, mouse and gamepad, so the phone can be controlled without USB debugging.

touchMethods.name: esp32
touchMethods.title: ESP32
touchMethods.description: Touches, keys and the gamepad go through the ESP32 touch box; set its serial port or Wi-Fi on the Extensions page.

zh_CN.name: ESP32 触控盒
zh_CN.description: 接在手机 USB 口或蓝牙上的 ESP32 开发板充当手机的触摸屏、键盘、鼠标和手柄，不开 USB 调试也能控制手机。
zh_CN.touchMethods.esp32.title: ESP32
zh_CN.touchMethods.esp32.description: 触控、按键和手柄经 ESP32 触控盒发给手机；串口或 Wi-Fi 在扩展页设置。
